exhibit.title: El Reno
exhibit.record_match_basis: Date, county, start time, rating and event narrative agree. Nearby satellite tornadoes are separate records.
exhibit.introduction: Follow a documented path, then examine how footage can help reconstruct a changing storm. This first study brings a geographic timeline and a video research notebook into one place.

facts.label: Time-labeled positions in the NWS file

exhibit.map_note: NWS tornado outline, center path and time-labeled center positions. The shaded outline covers the event as a whole; it is not the tornado's shape at the selected minute. The marker has no physical size.
exhibit.time_note: KML labels are interpreted as PM CDT on May 31 using the accompanying NWS chronology. Playback steps through published minute labels without inventing intermediate observations.

discrepancies.title: An unresolved end time
discrepancies.text: The NWS narrative ends at 6:42 PM CDT. Its table and NCEI record end at 6:44 PM CDT. The geographic timeline's last label is 6:42. Both reported endings remain in the dossier.

discrepancies.title: Rating and appearance answer different questions
discrepancies.text: The damage rating does not specify the funnel's dimensions or recreate its appearance. Building a scene needs shot-level evidence about viewpoint, visibility and time.

coverage.video_review: Pecos Hank's description and available captions read; two paused visual samples are documented in the footage notebook. No continuous video or audio audit.
coverage.frame_registration: Sample times use approximate browser playback readings. Camera position and historical time remain unregistered. No measured speed or width is inferred.
coverage.caption_discrepancy: Caption near 5:43 says EF5; current description and NWS final rating say EF3. Audio has not been independently checked.
coverage.geometry: Original NWS KMZ preserved, hashed and converted to GeoJSON; source coordinate sequences retained.
coverage.remaining: Shot registration, complete video review, third-party image permissions, geolocated damage evidence, and an appearance reconstruction. No 3D storm or damage simulator yet.

geometry.transformation: KML longitude/latitude preserved; altitude omitted for 2D display. No geometry interpolation.

notebook.title: A closer look at the footage
notebook.introduction: These notes link to places in the original video. Visual samples and the creator's annotations have different evidence labels. None is synchronized with the map yet.
notebook.timing_note: Sample times are approximate browser playback readings, not decoded frame identifiers. Edited elapsed time does not establish historical time or continuous storm evolution.

observations.title: An obscured lower boundary
observations.note: A broad dark lowering fills the background above a field and house. Its visible edge does not supply a measurable ground circulation boundary.
observations.next: Locate the foreground landmarks and camera direction before attempting any size estimate.

observations.title: The wide view
observations.note: The creator identifies the broad feature at this timestamp as the wedge. This is an attributed interpretation, not a measured outline.
observations.next: Compare registered viewpoints with the documented circulation.

observations.title: A changing appearance
observations.note: The description flags a lifted, flattened base. That appearance alone cannot establish that the tornado ended.
observations.next: Review the surrounding shots continuously and register any edits.

observations.title: Foreground landmarks
observations.note: A house, vehicle and raised structure provide foreground references beneath a broad lowering. One still cannot establish motion or wind speed.
observations.next: Match persistent landmarks using documented locations, then estimate viewing direction.

observations.title: A separate tornado
observations.note: The description identifies a smaller anticyclonic tornado here. Keep this lead separate from the main tornado until independently matched.
observations.next: Identify the corresponding official event; do not attach it to the main path by proximity.
